kpis.description_fr: Net Interest Margin (NIM). KPI clé d'une banque commerciale. Pression 2024-2025 sur deposit beta (clients demandent meilleurs taux). MUFG Union Bank acquisition (déc 2022) intégrée.
kpis.description_en: Net Interest Margin (NIM). Commercial bank key KPI. 2024-2025 pressure on deposit beta (customers demand higher rates). MUFG Union Bank acquisition (Dec 2022) integrated.

kpis.description_fr: CET1 ratio sous Bâle III. KPI capital régulé top-of-funnel. Reconstitution 2023-2024 post MUFG. Capacité reprise rachats actions à confirmer.
kpis.description_en: CET1 ratio under Basel III. Top-of-funnel regulatory capital KPI. 2023-2024 rebuild post MUFG. Buyback resumption capacity TBD.

kpis.description_fr: Encours moyen total des prêts (commercial + consumer + real estate). Pression croissance 2023-2025 (taux haut + standards crédit). MUFG ajoute ~80 G$.
kpis.description_en: Average total loan book (commercial + consumer + real estate). 2023-2025 growth pressure (high rates + credit standards). MUFG adds ~$80B.

kpis.description_fr: Revenus segment Payment Services (Elavon, corporate cards). Différenciateur US Bancorp = banque + processeur paiements (Elavon = top 5 acquéreurs).
kpis.description_en: Payment Services segment revenue (Elavon, corporate cards). USB differentiator = bank + payments processor (Elavon = top 5 acquirers).

kpis.description_fr: NPL ratio. KPI qualité du crédit. Hausse modérée 2024-2025 sur Commercial Real Estate office. Allowance for credit losses 2,1 %.
kpis.description_en: NPL ratio. Credit quality KPI. Modest 2024-2025 rise on Commercial Real Estate office. Allowance for credit losses 2.1%.

kpis_story.description_fr: Fin intégration MUFG Union Bank (acquise 2022) en 2024. Synergies de coûts $900M run-rate atteintes. Expansion West Coast (CA notamment) renforcée.
kpis_story.description_en: MUFG Union Bank integration finalized (acquired 2022) in 2024. $900M run-rate cost synergies achieved. Strengthened West Coast (notably CA) expansion.

_notes: U.S. Bancorp : KPIs banque (NIM, CET1, Loan Book, NPL) + différenciateur Payment Services Elavon.
